title: Azerbaijan money pack
description: Replace Minecraft valuables with Azerbaijani manat banknotes.
body:
# Azerbaijan Money Pack

## Added

* Replaced Iron Ingot with 1 Manat banknote
* Replaced Copper Ingot with 10 Manat banknote
* Replaced Emerald with 50 Manat banknote
* Replaced Diamond with 100 Manat banknote

## Changed

* Added custom item names for all banknotes
* Added Azerbaijani manat themed textures
